statements.context: Floor debate on the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (H.R. 1) in the House Rules Committee.

statements.text: I move the committee make in order amendment No. 215, offered by Representative Rivas, which strikes the provision creating a moratorium on States or political subdivisions from enforcing any law or regulation limiting, restricting, or regulating artificial intelligence models, artificial intelligence systems, or automated decision systems entered into interstate commerce.
statements.context: House Rules Committee debate on H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, where Mr. McGovern moves to make in order an amendment striking a federal moratorium on state AI regulation.

statements.text: Ms. Bonamici, I am glad you brought up the AI aspect of this. I am scared out of my mind that there will be a 10-year moratorium on States' ability to be able to kind of regulate AI within their boundaries.
statements.context: Floor debate during markup of H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, in the House Rules Committee.

statements.text:
Hey @RepMTG—you said you voted for the bill and you “would have voted NO if I had known [a provision preventing AI regulation] was in there.” 

You’re getting a second chance later today. Will you actually vote against it now?

Even Elon Musk’s AI chatbot knows that Republicans are in bed with billionaires and the banking lobby. Why else would they make it easier for banks to charge higher overdraft fees?

No working American asked for this shit. But the wealthy elite certainly did.
statements.quoted: @Cordero258 @Logically_JC Based on recent reports, the American Bankers Association and other banking lobbies pushed to overturn the CFPB's $5 overdraft fee cap, arguing it would limit services. Consumers didn't ask—banks did, to protect profits. Sources: NYT, Politico, ABA statements.

statements.text:
AI data centers are using tons of electricity & water, driving up utility costs while workers get left behind & Big Tech reaps record profits.

Proud to join @RepAOC & @SenSanders in calling for a federal AI data center moratorium until Congress sets real standards & guardrails to protect Americans.
This is why I’m calling for a federal AI data center moratorium. The rich donors who write this garbage for Trump want a nice fat return on their investment.
We ought to at least give members the opportunity to vote on the national moratorium.
statements.venue: Quoted in NOTUS on data center moratorium

statements.text: What a weak, powerless, impotent answer. If Congress won’t act, who the hell will, @SpeakerJohnson? Are the Data centers and tech bro billionaires making a fortune off AI going to regulate themselves? Give me a break!
statements.quoted: Johnson calls for AI solutions but says Congress won't take the lead https://t.co/kjyEmH3nE5

statements.text: Congress should be working around the clock to lower costs, address the affordability crisis, and confront the existential threat of AI. Instead, @speakerjohnson is sending Republicans home early to campaign in a last-ditch attempt to salvage his failing majority. Disgusting. https://t.co/mq6lFjyAjf
Congress should be working to put safeguards on AI & address the affordability crisis. Instead, @SpeakerJohnson is sending his conference home to campaign. It’s disgusting. https://t.co/noza8Mn4Ft

AI experts say there’s a greater than 10% chance their technology could wipe out humanity within a decade. Even a fraction of that possibility is unacceptable.

So what are Republicans doing about it? Absolutely NOTHING.

Totally unfit to lead. https://t.co/xK11u7OJQz

Industry leaders are sounding the alarm on AI, begging for Congress to put safeguards on them.

The American People are struggling with an affordability crisis caused by Trump’s stupid tariffs & his reckless war of choice with Iran.

Diesel prices are at an all-time high. Gas is through the roof. We’re burning billions of dollars on a reckless war that’s claiming American lives.

And @SpeakerJohnson is sending us home. Again. Because he cares more about his members campaigning to get reelected than solving the major issues facing our country.

It’s pathetic.

today is the houses last day until after Election Day.

statements.text:
Left unchecked, AI poses immense risks to humanity. We must take fast action to ensure that human rights are safeguarded from AI threats. Today at 2p ET, I’m chairing a hearing on the human rights implications of AI in the military domain. Tune in live:

https://t.co/x2KElMJfsE
He literally thinks AI is Terminator-style killer robots. We are so screwed.
statements.quoted: Trump: "The very same people who said we'll all be dead in 12 years because of global warming -- a name since reborn to climate change because the planet was cooling, not warming -- these are the same people that are now saying AI is going to kill us all, that robots are going to attack us."

statements.text: We need to pump the brakes on the AI arms race so we can put safeguards in place to protect the environment and our communities. [...] When it comes to something this consequential and potentially dangerous as AI, we can't just figure out regulations later while Big Tech steamrolls forward. We need action and a regulatory strategy that doesn't kick folks to the side.

Americans don’t want a surveillance state—and they sure as hell don’t want Big Tech using AI to track our every move & sell our data to the highest bidder.

This technology threatens our privacy rights & is ripe for abuse by the government & Big Tech. It must be stopped.
statements.quoted: The Trump administration is using a decades-old grant program to force cities nationwide to hand over Flock camera data to federal surveillance centers. https://t.co/yycSd8ljAy

Great to join @RepLoriTrahan at the annual NCMCC congressional luncheon hosted by @fitchburg_state to talk with folks about the issues affecting their lives—from Trump’s illegal war of choice in Iran and ICE terrorizing our communities, to Republicans’ cruel cuts to healthcare, Trump’s stupid tariffs, the affordable housing crisis, and the existential threat of AI.
